name: aicss
title_zh: AI 对话界面不重造轮子，现成思考态与流式输出组件
tagline_zh: 思考中、流式输出这类 AI 会话专用的界面部件，npm 装 React 版，或用 CLI 取 React／Vue／Svelte 源码直接落进你的项目。
tagline_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
desc_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
why_zh: AI 产品的界面反复要造同一批零件，这里把它们做成了能直接取走的成品，还带在线预览。
why_en: Every AI product rebuilds the same handful of chat-UI parts; these are finished, with live previews.
limit_zh: 它不是 SKILL.md 形态的 agent skill，装不进 agent，是 npm 包和 CLI，要你自己写代码接。免费组件在 npm 上；Pro 组件不在，要用 CLI 配 AICSS_TOKEN，那是付费的。文档站是闭源的，这个仓只是包源码。
limit_en: Not a SKILL.md agent skill — an npm package and CLI you wire up yourself. Free components on npm; Pro ones need a paid AICSS_TOKEN.
title_en: AI chat UI parts: thinking states & streaming output, no.
